text.description_html:
Omnia AP-9465, 14 mm Diameter Brushed Stainless Steel Refrigerator/Appliance Pull

This slim and sleek appliance door pull is crafted from 1/2 inch (14 mm) diameter high grade solid stainless steel with a Brushed Stainless Steel Finish. It requires little maintenance. Designed to enhance any setting where a modern, sophisticated look is desired. It is available in 3 sizes. choose from 17-5/8 inch, 25-3/16 inch, or 29 inch center to centers.

Also Available Matching Stainless Steel Cabinet Pulls

Features of the Omnia AP-9465 Stainless Steel Appliance Pull:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Available in 3 Sizes:

    AP-9465/448:
    • Center to Center Length: 17-5/8" (c.c.)
    • Total Length: 20-1/2"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Pull Diameter: 14 mm (1/2") (Very Slim)

    AP-9465/640:
    • Center to Center Length: 25-3/16" (c.c.)
    • Total Length: 28-3/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Pull Diameter: 14 mm (1/2") (Very Slim)

    AP-9465/736:
    • Center to Center Length: 29" (c.c.)
    • Total Length: 32-1/4"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Pull Diameter: 14 mm (1/2") (Very Slim)

Sold Individually
